items.title: Gary Marcus 借 Jensen Huang 言论主张暂时关停 OpenAI / "I think the answer is we have to shut the labs down" - Jensen Huang
items.source: Gary Marcus：The Road to AI We Can Trust（RSS）

sources.title: Gary Marcus 借 Jensen Huang 言论主张暂时关停 OpenAI / "I think the answer is we have to shut the labs down" - Jensen Huang
sources.title_zh: Gary Marcus 借 Jensen Huang 言论主张暂时关停 OpenAI
sources.title_en: "I think the answer is we have to shut the labs down" - Jensen Huang
sources.title_original: "I think the answer is we have to shut the labs down" - Jensen Huang
sources.summary: Gary Marcus 引用 Jensen Huang 接受 Ezra Klein 访谈时的话，认为无法控制软件的公司应被关停，并据此主张暂时关停 OpenAI。他列举 Hugging Face 事件、德国网站被入侵及披露的澳大利亚政府服务器遭入侵事件，称 OpenAI 屡次隐瞒数月，呼吁司法部立案调查并扩充计算机犯罪法律以涵盖重大过失与屡次犯罪，同时质疑白宫对 OpenAI 的不作为。
